upstream.current_stack: Frappe Framework (Python/JavaScript), Frappe UI (Vue), framework-managed database, authentication, roles and REST API

decision: Adopt product concepts and original learning outcomes; do not port or bundle upstream code in EDUNEXUS by default. Treat production accounting integration as a separately gated future project.
reusable_concepts: Chart of accounts and general ledger
Trial balance, profit-and-loss, balance-sheet and cash-flow reporting
Quotation, invoice, receipt/payment and returns workflows
Purchase bills, expenses and supplier payments
Responsive finance interface and printable documents

learning_modules.title: Dasar Akuntansi dan Persamaan Akuntansi
learning_modules.practice: Classify assets, liabilities, equity, revenue and expenses; explain debit/credit with a balanced example.

learning_modules.title: Jurnal Berpasangan dan Buku Besar
learning_modules.practice: Post sample transactions and prove total debits equal total credits; reconcile a trial balance.

learning_modules.title: Proyek Buku Kas dan Laporan Usaha Mikro
learning_modules.practice: Build a fictional business ledger, invoice/payment records, expense register and monthly profit/loss report using synthetic data.

learning_modules.title: Proyek Anggaran Kursus dan Institusi
learning_modules.practice: Compare planned versus actual course revenue/cost, mentor fees, scholarships and remaining budget with mock data.

learning_modules.title: Simulasi Faktur dan Rekonsiliasi Pembayaran
learning_modules.practice: Trace quote-to-invoice-to-payment, identify overdue balances and reconcile payment records using fictional customers.

learning_modules.title: Persediaan dan Dampak Transaksi
learning_modules.practice: Model stock receipts/issues and explain how inventory transactions affect a sample ledger; no real stock mutation.

future_production_gates: Review Indonesian accounting/tax requirements against current official sources and qualified professional guidance.
Keep all finance data in the existing Neon architecture; do not add Frappe hosting or external services by default.
Require organization-scoped authorization and isolation tests for every finance record.
Use decimal-safe currency arithmetic, balanced journal constraints, idempotent posting, audit trails and reversal entries.
Separate draft from posted transactions; require explicit human approval for posting, payouts, tax treatment and period close.
Run two-account authorization tests, concurrency/idempotency tests, ledger invariants and backup/restore checks before real money workflows.
Keep AI in advisory/drafting mode; never let agents independently post or pay money.
